items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 86:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Netzach and Hod being one in the back? The quality of Netzach is that it is the aspect of the carrier for the illumination of Hochma, and the quality of Hod is that it is the aspect of the carrier for the screen upon which the coupling of striking is made. For from the aspect of the building of the Partzuf, Netzach is discerned as the aspect of ZA, similar to the crown of Hesed in the Mochin, which is the aspect of ZA and the carrier for the illumination of Hochma. And Hod is similar to the crown of Gevura, which is in the Mochin the aspect of the carrier for the screens. As above in Answer 6, see there. And therefore “the Netzach and Hod are one in the aspect of the back”, for when ZON are back to back, they are VAK without a head, and there is no aspect of the illumination of Hochma there at all. Therefore the quality of Netzach is not revealed at all, and it is included in Hod. But with the coming of the Hassadim, which are the Mochin of the GAR of ZON, then the Netzach and Hod are separated, for Netzach becomes the carrier for the illumination of Hochma, and Hod for the aspect of the reflected light. (Item 75).
